title: Motie van het lid Beckerman over een bevoegde instantie aanwijzen om ook deepfakeporno en andere onrechtmatige seksuele beelden offline te halen

reading.body:
Deepfake pornographic videos featuring the likenesses of Dutch public figures were created and hosted on a platform with millions of monthly visitors. The videos used generative AI to place victims' faces onto pornographic content without consent, affecting entertainers, athletes, politicians, and members of the Royal Family. The deployment required no meaningful check: the platform permitted creation and distribution of non-consensual sexual imagery at scale.

This is a failure of the system operator to prevent a known harmful use of image synthesis technology. The platform hosts content that is illegal under revenge porn laws in the jurisdiction, yet made it available to millions. It would have taken content moderation, age verification, consent checks, or detection systems to stop this before it reached victims. Whether the platform operator knew of the content before complaints were filed is not established.

summary:
Several Dutch female celebrities are considering filing charges after discovering they appear in fake pornographic videos. These manipulated videos, which digitally place a person's head onto a pornographic performer's body, are posted on an online platform that receives approximately 13 million monthly visitors. The platform reportedly contains numerous fake videos featuring Dutch entertainers, television presenters, Olympic athletes, government officials, and members of the Royal Family. Interim Justice Minister Yesilgöz called the videos "sickening" and encouraged victims to report the crimes.

Multiple victims and their representatives have confirmed to news outlets that they have filed complaints or are considering legal action. Deepfake pornography falls under revenge porn laws and is therefore criminal. Legal experts recommend that victims file reports, which could enable prosecutors to shut down the websites hosting the material. Additional options include launching group lawsuits, filing complaints with data protection authorities, or contacting hosting companies. Previously, television presenter Welmoed Sijtsma made a documentary about her experience as a victim, leading to a 39-year-old man from Amersfoort receiving a conditional sentence of 180 hours in November.
title_en: Motion by member Beckerman on designating a competent authority to also remove deepfake pornography and other unlawful sexual images offline
